theorem append_assoc {α : Type*} (xs ys zs : List α) :
    (xs ++ ys) ++ zs = xs ++ (ys ++ zs)

theorem append_Nil2 {α : Type*} (xs : List α) :
    xs ++ [] = xs

theorem rev_append {α : Type*} (xs ys : List α) :
    (xs ++ ys).reverse = ys.reverse ++ xs.reverse

theorem map_append {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (xs ys : List α) :
    (xs ++ ys).map f = xs.map f ++ ys.map f

theorem length_append {α : Type*} (xs ys : List α) :
    (xs ++ ys).length = xs.length + ys.length

theorem map_map {α β γ : Type*} (f : β → γ) (g : α → β) (xs : List α) :
    (xs.map g).map f = xs.map (f ∘ g)

theorem rev_map {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (xs : List α) :
    (xs.map f).reverse = xs.reverse.map f

theorem rev_rev_ident {α : Type*} (xs : List α) :
    xs.reverse.reverse = xs

theorem length_map {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (xs : List α) :
    (xs.map f).length = xs.length

theorem filter_append {α : Type*} (P : α → Bool) (xs ys : List α) :
    (xs ++ ys).filter P = xs.filter P ++ ys.filter P

theorem add_0_right (m : ℕ) :
    m + 0 = m

theorem add_mult_distrib (m n k : ℕ) :
    (m + n) * k = m * k + n * k

theorem add_mult_distrib2 (k m n : ℕ) :
    k * (m + n) = k * m + k * n

theorem Un_commute {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) :
    A ∪ B = B ∪ A

theorem Int_commute {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) :
    A ∩ B = B ∩ A

theorem Un_assoc {α : Type*} (A B C : Set α) :
    (A ∪ B) ∪ C = A ∪ (B ∪ C)

theorem Int_assoc {α : Type*} (A B C : Set α) :
    (A ∩ B) ∩ C = A ∩ (B ∩ C)

theorem Un_absorb {α : Type*} (A : Set α) :
    A ∪ A = A

theorem Int_absorb {α : Type*} (A : Set α) :
    A ∩ A = A

theorem linorder_linear {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] (x y : α) :
    x ≤ y ∨ y ≤ x

theorem linorder_not_le {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] (x y : α) :
    (¬ x ≤ y) = (y < x)

theorem linorder_not_less {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] (x y : α) :
    (¬ x < y) = (y ≤ x)

theorem minus_minus {α : Type*} [AddGroup α] (a : α) :
    - - a = a

theorem diff_self {α : Type*} [AddGroup α] (a : α) :
    a - a = 0

theorem add_le_mono1 (i j k : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) :
    i + k ≤ j + k

theorem append_same_eq {α : Type*} (xs ys zs : List α) :
    (ys ++ xs = zs ++ xs) = (ys = zs)

theorem drop_append {α : Type*} (n : ℕ) (xs ys : List α) :
    (xs ++ ys).drop n = xs.drop n ++ ys.drop (n - xs.length)

theorem take_append {α : Type*} (n : ℕ) (xs ys : List α) :
    (xs ++ ys).take n = xs.take n ++ ys.take (n - xs.length)

theorem add_mset_commute {α : Type*} (x y : α) (M : Multiset α) :
    x ::ₘ y ::ₘ M = y ::ₘ x ::ₘ M

theorem set_append {α : Type*} (xs ys : List α) :
    {x | x ∈ xs ++ ys} = {x | x ∈ xs} ∪ {x | x ∈ ys}
